name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
summary: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited (ICBC), established in 1984 and headquartered in Beijing, is a major financial institution offering banking products in China and worldwide through corporate banking, personal banking and treasury operations. Corporate banking serves enterprises, governments and financial organizations with lending, trade finance, deposits, custody and wealth management, while personal banking provides loans, cards, deposits and advisory. It also offers e-banking, investment banking, leasing and insurance.
